details:
SPACE LEGACY: Every Abandoned Object Has a Story

SPACE LEGACY is an interactive educational website developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It explores abandoned and inactive spacecraft, landers, rovers, and scientific equipment left behind during space exploration missions on the Moon, Mars, and beyond.

The website presents 13 space missions through informative cards with images, mission details, historical information, and scientific contributions.

Key Features:

  • Interactive mission cards.
  • Search option to find specific missions.
  • Category filters for Moon, Mars, and Beyond the Planets.
  • Popup windows with mission details.
  • Mission timeline.
  • Favourites feature to save interesting missions.
  • Responsive design for desktop and mobile devices.

Technologies Used: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Data Sources: NASA's Space Science Data Coordinated Archive (NSSDCA), NASA Science, and official NASA resources.

Our goal is to tell the stories of these forgotten space explorers and highlight how their missions contributed to science and humanity. Even when a mission ends, its legacy lives on.
